name: Ken Enterprises Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1998, Ken Enterprises Limited is engaged in the business of textile manufacturing.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Ken Enterprise Ltd, headquartered in Ichalkaranji, is an ISO 9001:2015 certified textile manufacturer specializing in greige and finished fabrics with over 1,000 SKU's

pros: Stock is trading at 0.98 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 29.4% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 10.6% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.12.2 Cr.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
Working capital days have increased from 41.4 days to 61.7 days
